what: `store` returned every refusal with its reason in `Stored.refused`, and nothing read the field: why a crate has no image was recorded nowhere. On reth's restart build 827 crate names were resolved from source and 291 read from images; the profile could not say why.
cost: an hour of three lanes asking the same question of a profile that could not answer
cause: a result returned to a caller that drops it
class: a silent refusal (rule no-fallback: failures are loud)
prevention: built: one event a refusal (`a crate's image is not written`, krate, kind, why) and `Refused::kind()`. First rows, a hello-world: 80 crates, all `encode` (the def map holds a path below the daemon's home). A records lane wrote the serve-side reason a crate is not asked (`why_not_eligible`)
state: fixed (the event); the 80 refusals themselves are the records lanes'
